column1: # ReConnect China CITY-tier source map vs. our coverage — built 2026-09-03

#   Pinyin/English from assets/item-url-BR2Rzb8A.js name->EN dict. NO document endpoints touched.
# TOTALS: 368 city-tier units = 335 cities + 4 municipalities + 29 special.
#   HAVE = 20 cities (14 Guangdong: gz sz zhuhai zhongshan huizhou yangjiang shantou shanwei
#   shaoguan jiangmen jieyang heyuan yunfu zhaoqing; + suzhou wuhan hangzhou qingdao jinan shenyang)
#   7 reachable(200) / 3 waf(4xx) / 15 blackhole(000)  ->  ~28% crawlable from NYC
#   Matches CLAUDE.md finding: most CN gov portals blackhole datacenter IPs. Only ~1 in 4 NEW cities is directly crawlable.
# NOTE candidate_domain is the pinyin heuristic (www.<pinyin>.gov.cn); the 25 SAMPLED rows carry a VERIFIED domain
#   autonomous prefectures/counties/leagues/regions where the pinyin rule is unreliable. reachability=untested = not sampled.
